issues.description: Method mismatch for Lecture.toString(): the problem statement (and Java's Object contract) require a toString() that returns a String describing the lecture, but the solution implementation declares public Object toString() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java. Because Object.toString() has signature public String toString(), the differing return type prevents a proper override and, together with the @Override annotation present in the solution, will cause a compilation error and confuse students about the required signature.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution (and in any student implementation) change the signature of toString() to return String and keep the @Override annotation. For example: public String toString() { return "Lecture{" + "lectureName='" + lectureName + "'" + ", numberOfInscribedStudents='" + numberOfInscribedStudents + "'" + ", numberOfGuestStudents='" + numberOfGuestStudents + "'" + ", numberOfLecturers='" + numberOfLecturers + "'" + ", numberOfTutors='" + numberOfTutors + "'" + '}'; } This makes the method correctly override Object.toString(), compiles cleanly, and matches the problem statement's requirement.
